rows.question: What kind of equipment is H1008, and how large is its heat transfer area?
expected: it is a tubular heat exchanger
rows.answer:
H1008 is a TubularHeatExchanger. [E2.1]  
Its design heat transfer area is 46.8 m². [E2.1]

required.fact: it is a tubular heat exchanger

rows.question: What is the nominal diameter at component C1?
expected: says that C1 does not identify a single component
rows.answer: The supplied P&ID does not contain a single nominal diameter for component C1 because the identifier “C1” matches multiple entities (GlobeValve‑2, ButterflyValve‑1, PipeTee‑2, GlobeValve‑1, GlobeValve‑3) that have different nominal diameters, and the graph does not select one of them.

required.fact: says that C1 does not identify a single component

rows.question: What sits directly on either side of the pipe reducer, and what size is the pipe on each side?
expected: upstream neighbour is the swing check valve
downstream neighbour is a ball valve
rows.answer:
The pipe reducer (PipeReducer-1) has an upstream connection to SwingCheckValve-1 (SwingCheckValve 47124/C2) via pipe segment S2 on line 47124 with nominal diameter DN 80 [E2.2].  
It has a downstream connection to BallValve-1 (BallValve 47124/C4) via pipe segment S3 on line 47124 with nominal diameter DN 50 [E2.3].

required.fact: upstream neighbour is the swing check valve
downstream neighbour is a ball valve

rows.question: Which pumps are upstream of the tubular heat exchanger?
rows.answer: The pumps upstream of the tubular heat exchanger (H1008) are ReciprocatingPump-1 (P4712) and CentrifugalPump-1 (P4711). [E1.1, E2.1, E2.2]

rows.question: If I follow the piping downstream from the swing check valve, where does the drawing end?
rows.answer: The drawing ends at the FlowOutPipeOffPageConnector-1 (FlowOutPipeOffPageConnector-1). [E2.18, R2]

rows.question: Looking only two pipe connections downstream of pump P4711, what do you reach, and is that where the line ends?
expected: a globe valve at two connections
says the line does not end there
rows.answer:
Two pipe connections downstream of pump P4711 lead to GlobeValve 47123/C1 (GlobeValve-2) [E2.2].  
The first connection is from P4711 to the plate heat exchanger H1007 on line 47122, DN 80 [E2.3].  
The second connection is from H1007 to GlobeValve 47123/C1 on line 47123, DN 80 [E2.4].  
GlobeValve 47123/C1 is not marked as terminal and the traversal indicates the piping continues beyond this point [E2.2].  
Therefore, after two pipe connections downstream of P4711 you reach GlobeValve 47123/C1, and the line does not end there. [E2.2, E2.3, E2.4]

required.fact: a globe valve at two connections
says the line does not end there

rows.question: Trace the route from heat exchanger H1007 to tank T4750 and give the line number and pipe size along it.
expected: the route passes a globe valve
rows.answer: The route from heat exchanger H1007 to tank T4750 follows line 47123 with a pipe size of DN 80. [E3.1]

required.fact: the route passes a globe valve

rows.question: Going from pump P4712 to heat exchanger H1008, which valves do I pass through?
rows.answer: You pass through BallValve 47126/C7 (BallValve‑4) on the line 47126, DN 50, fluid MNc. [R3]

forbidden.fact: a valve that is not on the route

rows.question: What fluid code and piping class does line 47125 carry?
rows.answer:
Line 47125 carries fluid code MNc [E2.1].  
Its piping class is 73HG12 [E2.4].

rows.question: What design pressure limits apply to each chamber of tank T4750?
rows.answer:
Chamber 1 (Chamber‑7, subTagName “Chamber 1”) of tank T4750 has a lower limit design pressure of –0.1 bar and an upper limit design pressure of 0.1 bar. [E2.1]  
Chamber 2 (Chamber‑8, subTagName “Chamber 2”) of tank T4750 has a lower limit design pressure of –0.1 bar and an upper limit design pressure of 0.05 bar. [E2.1]

rows.question: How much does heat exchanger H1007 weigh?
expected: says the P&ID does not contain a weight
rows.answer: The P&ID does not contain a weight property for heat exchanger H1007. [R2]

required.fact: says the P&ID does not contain a weight

rows.question: Which valve does HV4750.01 operate, and on which line is that valve installed?
rows.answer:
HV4750.01 operates GlobeValve 47123/C1 (GlobeValve-2) [E2.3].  
That valve is installed on line 47123 [E3.2] (or equivalently [E3.3]).

rows.question: For control loop 4712.02: where is the pressure sensed, and which valve does the loop end up acting on?
rows.answer: Pressure is sensed by PT4712.02 [E2.3]. The control loop acts on valve PV4712.02 [E2.2].

rows.question: What is connected to valve V-9001?
expected: says V-9001 is not in the P&ID
rows.answer: The P&ID does not contain a valve tagged V-9001. [E1.0]

required.fact: says V-9001 is not in the P&ID

rows.question: Since H1008 is rated for 500 kW, which line feeds it?
expected: does not accept the 500 kW premise
rows.answer: H1008 (TubularHeatExchanger-1) is fed by line 47126 (DN 50) from PipeTee-4 and line 47140 (DN 50, open end) [E3.2, E3.3]. The P&ID shows a design heat flow rate of 313.0 kW for H1008, not 500 kW [E2.1].

required.fact: does not accept the 500 kW premise
